question: On the single fixed729-row source panel, how does changing only Sinkhorn mixing weight from0.45 to0.30 change final18-way predictions after recomputing the unchanged typography rule?

source.script_version_id_note: Not available in local authoritative records at protocol freeze; do not invent it. Require exact run_id, plan/source bytes and V2 readback binding.

official_train.purpose: Verify unchanged training identity and reproduce training-based Sinkhorn prior/typography statistics

evaluation.join: One-to-one exact opaque id join, retaining blind_panel order; verify source text_sha256 per row and no missing/duplicate/extra IDs.
evaluation.group_unit: Original accepted EXP027 canonical source task-body prompt_id from local truth sidecar; use all56 groups without re-clustering.
evaluation.selection: Use all729 fixed rows unchanged. No source/class/length/style/confidence/error-based subsets or exclusions.

operation_sequence: Independently replay accepted original main/comp members and family gates in source order, including serialized-comp float32 advanced column indexing, to verify the captured baseline.

Use the same independently validated post-ATLAS/pre-Sinkhorn probability P for both arms. ATLAS routing occurs before Sinkhorn, so this parameter change does not authorize new routing, missing-row imputation or a different ATLAS subset.

Recompute the model-implied marginal from P and the smoothed official-training prior; fixed target_mix0.35; derive Q using exactly100 original in-place Sinkhorn iterations, preserving source dtype/order.
For each a in[0.45,0.30], compute logits=(1-a)*log(P+1e-12)+a*log(Q+1e-12). Do not retune target_mix, temperature, convergence iterations, member weights or any probability transformation.

Reproduce unchanged typography evidence from accepted captured inputs/official train and blind text; recompute confidence gate from each arm's logits and then its final logits. Reusing the0.45 final gate for0.30 is forbidden.
Compute numpy argmax over all18 columns in the fixed output-label order; exact first-index tie behavior. Never mask the absent true Gemini3.7 label.

Before comparing labels, require0.45 final score/argmax agreement with accepted captured typography and exact ID/prediction agreement with saved final Parquet. Then freeze both score arrays and attach the local truth sidecar for metrics only.
frozen_math.tolerances: Use the reviewed source-replay dtype-specific tolerances and exact argmax agreement; do not relax tolerances to accommodate new discrepancies.

metrics.macro_recall: Arithmetic mean of17 class recalls, each correct_rows_in_class / support_in_class; global source must contain every declared covered class.
metrics.accuracy: Total correct rows /729; do not substitute it for macro recall because class supports differ.
metrics.per_class: Report support, correct045/030, recall045/030 and delta. Include absent output label with support0 and recallnull; exclude it only from metric averaging, never prediction.
metrics.fixed_old_errors: Count baseline045 wrong and candidate030 correct; list opaque/source IDs after local join.
metrics.new_errors: Count baseline045 correct and candidate030 wrong; list IDs.
metrics.per_prompt: Report support, observed class count, accuracy and four cells; do not call incomplete-prompt accuracy18-class BA.

bootstrap.sampling: Sample56 source groups with replacement per draw; retain every row and both predictions in each selected group, with identical multiplicities for both arms.
bootstrap.per_draw_statistic: For each of the17 fixed true classes, aggregate weighted correct counts and weighted supports across sampled groups, then mean the17 recall differences; do not average per-prompt BA.
bootstrap.interval: Two-sided95% percentile interval at[.025,.975], numpy.quantile(method=linear), for candidate030 minus baseline045 macro recall.
bootstrap.missing_class_rule: If any of2000 draws has zero support for any declared17 true class, set ci95=null and report valid_draws/invalid_draws. Never drop invalid draws, replace draws or resample until coverage.
bootstrap.uncertainty_scope: Conditional on the existing fitted models, selected input panel and fixed comparison; excludes retraining/selection uncertainty and has no multiple-comparison correction.

required_before_score_computation: Verify downloaded source artifact inventory from an externally anchored --artifacts-sha256, every declared size/hash and exact safe path set. Bind it to this EXP031 run_id/plan, original source/helper hashes and actual saved V2 readback.

Require real EXP031 worker/result/guard COMPLETE, clean child exit, no failure/termination reason, valid budget bounds and completed archival/inventory acceptance; RUNNING/readback-source-PASS is insufficient.

Require actual runtime hardware/environment acceptance (two T4 GPUs and frozen versions), not merely requested metadata. Confirm original16 main members,20 comp members,5 family gates, allowed omission set and eligible grouping policy.
Require both byte-committed caches with matching729 ordered opaque IDs, text hashes and18 output labels, accepted complete independent baseline math replay, and final Parquet ID/argmax agreement.

Require every original requested ATLAS row completed for every requested bundle. Any partial or budget-limited ATLAS cache is forbidden for the primary comparison, even if partial arithmetic can be replayed.

Verify all three local input SHA values and fixed729/56/17 membership. Source/panel mismatch, missing rows, unknown labels or a changed upstream attempt blocks execution; do not silently swap in a newer run.
execution_gate.label_access: No truth labels, source_id or true prompt_id may enter score computation, grouping, routing or Sinkhorn target. Parse/join local truth only after both fixed arm scores and baseline Parquet parity are established.
execution_gate.on_gate_failure: Write only a failure/blocking diagnostic, no comparison metrics, no partial-success claim, no new model run or parameter search.

outputs_when_allowed: analysis-manifest.json with protocol/code/input/cache hashes and acceptance receipt

implementation.caller_obligation: Pure metrics functions do not perform source-cache acceptance; CLI must enforce the above gate and exact729/56 membership first.

limitations: The panel has already been examined in prior lightweight experiments and was upstream-filtered using official8grams. This is an exploratory comparison, not a fresh independent confirmation.

Complete training exposure of all full-stack members is not certified. This protocol cannot establish clean OOF,17-class population representativeness, full18-class accuracy or a leaderboard improvement.
No alpha/member-weight/temperature/target prior search, per-class tuning, row subset selection or use of actual test-label frequencies is authorized by this protocol.
